DEVELOPMENT AND LICENSE AGREEMENT (testing paraphrase)

4.1 The licensee owes a running royalty calculated using Net Sales of the covered products.

4.2 The applicable rates for each agreement year are 6% on Net Sales up to $500,000; 4% from $500,000 to $2,500,000; 2% between $2,500,000 and $20,000,000; and 1% above $20,000,000.

4.3 Minimum annual royalties include $50,000 for years three and four, $75,000 in years five to seven, $100,000 in years eight and nine, and $125,000 subsequently.

4.11 Late payments accrue interest at .5% monthly. This is not an earned royalty.

4.12 Sales to the licensor earn licensee a gross margin of 40%; these sales are excluded from the royalty base.

4.13 Royalties may be capped at $200,000 for a year if licensor does not perform specified support services.

6. An audit shortfall exceeding 5% affects reimbursement of audit fees; this is not a royalty rate.
